name: The Callisto Protocol｜《卡利斯托协议》

mods.name: Infinite Health｜无限生命
mods.description: Restores 生命值最大 ([rbx+0x11C]) into current 手机 ([rbx+0x118]) inside SetHealth. The stub is EFLAGS-保险箱 (pushfq/popfq): the instruction right after the hook site is a 'jbe' that consumes flags set before the store, so a plain 'cmp' in the stub crashes the game. Tested on firmware 14.00.

mods.name: 无限积分 (nothing is ever spent)
mods.description: Neuters the 背包 remover: 'sub r12d,edx' -> 'test r12d,r12d', so a slot quantity is written back unchanged while the following 'jle' still gets correct flags. Credits are an 背包物品, so this also stops weapon-upgrade costs. Consumables are not used up either. 笔记: your balance never rises, it only stops falling - you still cannot buy what you cannot already afford. Tested on firmware 14.00.

mods.name: 停止 Time Puzzles (Final 变速箱)
mods.description: NOPs the write to the 谜题 time-鳞片 field ([rdi+0x20C]). Direct port of the 01.26 cheat; the instruction is unique in the image. NOT verified in game yet - no Final 变速箱 谜题 was reached during testing.
